name: What is the process for starting a whole-home remodel with Simply Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for starting a whole-home remodel with Simply Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. Next, we develop preliminary designs and provide a detailed proposal. Once approved, we assist with material selections and handle all necessary permitting. Construction then commences with our experienced team, maintaining regular communication and site supervision. The project concludes with a final walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process starts with a consultation, followed by design and proposal development. After approval, we manage permitting and construction, ending with a final walkthrough.
